prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Exactly ONE complete WHITE RADISH / DAIKON seedling, the earliest SPROUT stage, for our 3D Jiangnan miniature farm.
Input 1 is the APPROVED paint and material reference only: rounded dimensional organic forms, selective fine moss-green contours, pale sage-green layered washes, broad pigment variation, softly shaded matte volume. Input 2 is the world visual language only.
Object structure: exactly TWO small plump nearly heart-shaped seed leaves with a soft rounded notch at each tip, forming a low open V. Each has a small short slender pale green stem; the stems connect to ONE very short ivory-white central base. No true-leaf cluster, no central extra leaf, no swollen harvestable radish bulb, no long root. Make the leaves more rounded heart-shaped and stalks slimmer than bok choy sprouts, but maintain identical painted colour family. Leaves have a real softly cupped thick volume, not flat paper cutouts. The tiny cream-white base is a single shared growing point.
Weak-perspective three-quarter view slightly above centre. Whole sprout with both leaf tips and the complete tiny base inside frame, generous 15% margin; neutral soft diffuse light, plain clean light grey background or true transparency, faint contact shadow only.
No pot, soil, trailing roots, scene, decorations, stand, separate pieces, text, watermark or collage. No photographic leaf veins, glossy plastic or uniform thick black outlines; no faded stone-grey leaves.
review: 完整单体与连通根部，淡彩色斑、细轮廓及阶段叶数清楚；仅图片验收，三维尚待1.2样片结论后生成。
